nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances; mutated unchecked in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances; decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Private mapping counting how many times an address has sold; incremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist; set true in _mints and read in ensure.
Private minimum sell amount, set in init, read in condition.
Private maximum sell amount, set in init, read in condition.
Private max number of sales per address, set in init, read in condition.
Address exempted from sale limits; set by setTradeAddress, read in ensure.
Privileged owner address set in constructor; gates delegate, _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress.
Constant Uniswap router address used as whitelisted sender in ensure.
Public total supply, minted to owner in the constructor.
Constant decimals value (18) used for scaling in _mints and init.
Public token name set in constructor.
Public token symbol set in constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Whitelist gate checking owner, UNI, tradeAddress, canSale; otherwise requires condition(); computes pair via CREATE2 derivation.
Core transfer routine: allowance check by msg.sender, ensure() gate, and unchecked balance updates plus _onSaleNum increment.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value with no zero-address validation.
Sale policy check against _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum[_from].
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied target and payload.
Privileged mint/whitelist function callable by owner or a hardcoded address; overwrites balanceOf[spender].
Owner-only initialization of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only airdrop that computes an unchecked total and loops over recipients with unchecked balance additions.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure CREATE2 pair address derivation using keccak256 and init code hash.
Deployer constructor that sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and a max allowance to the Uniswap router.
msg.sender used for owner-gating, allowance spending and balance debits.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) in delegate() executes arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom; underflow potential without SafeMath.
Unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom; overflow potential without SafeMath.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend; multiplication overflow.
Unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend; subtraction underflow.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument when transfer forwards to transferFrom.
msg.sender is used to spend another account's allowance.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve.
delegate() gates the arbitrary delegatecall on msg.sender == owner.
_mints() gates privileged minting on msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded address.
init() is restricted to msg.sender == owner.
batchSend() is restricted to msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress() is restricted to msg.sender == owner.
Constructor assigns ownership and full supply to msg.sender.
transfer() calls transferFrom().
transferFrom() calls ensure() before mutating balances.
ensure() calls condition() for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address.
ensure() compares _from/_to against owner for whitelist bypass.
ensure() treats the UNI router address as a whitelisted sender.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to bypass sale limits.
ensure() reads tradeAddress as a whitelisted sender.
transferFrom() reads and debits allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer.
transferFrom() performs unchecked subtraction on balanceOf[_from].
transferFrom() performs unchecked addition on balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom() performs unchecked subtraction on the allowance mapping.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition() reads _minSale to bound the transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to bound the transfer amount.
condition() reads _saleNum to limit sales per address.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall supplied by the caller.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the caller-supplied amount.
_mints() grants canSale[spender] = true, bypassing ensure().
_mints() scales addedValue by 10**decimals.
init() writes _minSale.
init() writes _maxSale.
init() writes _saleNum.
init() scales bounds by 10**decimals.
batchSend() debits and credits balanceOf for msg.sender and recipients.
batchSend() computes total with an unchecked multiplication.
batchSend() debits the total with an unchecked subtraction.
batchSend() restricts execution to the owner account.
setTradeAddress() overwrites the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Constructor sets owner to the deployer.
Constructor credits the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
Constructor mints totalSupply from _supply.
